Subject: Intro — met at Summit (inference use case)

Hi Kimberly,

Great to meet you at the West Coast Inference Summit yesterday — really appreciated the 1:1 at your booth. A quick recap from my side: ArcMetrics is evaluating ways to move our on-device + cloud hybrid inference (LLM-based summarization of clinical notes) to something more cost-stable and auditable. Two quick priorities we mentioned:

- Low 95th percentile latency for short prompts (≤ 300 tokens)
- Data controls and audit logs for regulated PII workflows

Can you send over a short recap of what you recommended (hosted vs private tradeoffs) and any prelim pricing ranges or pilot options? Happy to schedule a 30m follow-up with engineering — would you recommend someone from your side to join?

Best,
Raquel

Hi Raquel — thanks for stopping by and for the note. Great to meet you too. Picking up from our convo, here are the quick points and suggested next steps so we have a shared plan: 

Summary of fit:
- Use case: clinical-note summarization (short prompts, high volume).
- Priority: predictable latency at p95 and strong auditability / retention controls.
- Likely path: start hosted API pilot to validate latency & cost, then migrate to Redwood Private (VPC) if you need customer-managed networking and KMS.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical discovery call (30–45m) — include your infra/PII owner + our SE to review sample traffic and SLOs.
2) Share a mutual action plan (MAP) with timeline + success criteria — I can send a template.
3) Pilot: 2–4 week PoC on hosted with a small reserved capacity to measure p95 & cost.

I'm attaching a one-pager that summarizes hosting vs private tradeoffs and a short pricing primer. I'll propose times for a tech call — Marissa (our Solutions Eng) is the best person to walk through KV-cache, batching, and quantization options for this workload.

Proposed attendees from Redwood:
- Kimberly Park (Account Exec)
- Marissa Cole (Solutions Eng)
- Ben Carter (Sales Engineer) — optional for procurement/pricing questions

Files attached: redwood-inference-quickstart.pdf
MAP link: https://redwood.app/mutual-action-plans/AM-2026-031

Would tomorrow or Friday morning (PST) work for a 30m tech sync?

Cheers,
